opening: For three years I’ve run AWS and Kubernetes platforms for financial-infrastructure customers, usually from inside their environment rather than behind a ticket queue. Lately I’ve been building agent systems the same way — LangChain on Bedrock AgentCore, retrieval pipelines, agents that hold a conversation and then go do something.

about: I grew up wanting to know how things were wired, and ended up in the part of software where that’s the whole job. I joined Baton as an intern in 2023 and have spent the years since on financial infrastructure — the systems banks settle trades on, where a bad deploy is somebody’s money.
What I like most is the part that isn’t infrastructure: being on the call when the requirement is still vague, and staying on it until the thing runs.
